Its single entry remains a preflight candidate: status remains 'planned', last_reachability_evidence remains null, and p2p_host 203.0.113.10 remains a non-routable RFC 5737 (TEST-NET-3) documentation address. See docs/release/public-devnet/network/reachability/RUN_416_qbind-devnet-seed-1.md and docs/devnet/QBIND_DEVNET_EVIDENCE_RUN_416.md.

seed_nodes.notes: PREFLIGHT CANDIDATE - NOT A LIVE SEED. node_id/peer_id are REAL public identifiers produced by the Run 375 `qbind-node identity generate devnet seed` path; the corresponding ML-KEM-768 leaf secret and in-memory ML-DSA-44 root signing key were generated in an ephemeral temp directory and DISCARDED, so this identity is illustrative only and MUST be replaced by the operator's durable seed identity before any live publication. p2p_host 203.0.113.10 is an RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3 documentation address and is NOT externally reachable. status is 'planned' (NOT 'live') and last_reachability_evidence is null. External reachability itself is no longer unproven: Run 377 proved loopback/same-host reachability (Route B); Runs 378/388/391/393 attempted Route A but found no independent off-host vantage in the sandboxed environment (Route C); and Run 416 achieved the FIRST successful real external Route A reachability (external TCP + KEMTLS mutual-auth static-root) to a routable public seed from a genuinely independent off-host dialer (see network/reachability/RUN_416_qbind-devnet-seed-1.md). This candidate nevertheless stays 'planned' with null evidence because the Run 416 seed used a TEMPORARY, DISCARDED operator identity on a non-durable endpoint - NOT this candidate's durable identity - and no `devnet-seeds.live.json` is published. To promote to status 'live': stand up a DURABLE externally reachable KEMTLS static-root seed bound to this candidate's own identity, capture external reachability evidence from an independent external vantage point, set p2p_host/p2p_multiaddr/operator to the real public values, set status 'live', and set last_reachability_evidence to the evidence reference. `qbind-node identity register-check --status live --reachability-evidence <ref>` accepts exactly that shape and fails closed without the evidence reference.
